author: sbaldu
body:
#### PR description:

* Introduces a new `CaloClusterSoA` based on SoA blocks for representing generic clusters in the calorimeter.
* Re-implements the alpaka layer cluster producer to use the CLUEstering library
* Updates the configuration to use the alpaka LC producer for all calorimeter regions
* Removes the legacy LC producer, `HGCalCLUEAlgo` and `ImagingAlgo`


FYI @waredjeb @felicepantaleo @AuroraPerego @Electricks94 @mmarriot
title: Implement `CaloClusterSoA` for TICL layer clusters
